ei.subject: 수능특강 영어
ei.title: Sharing as Insurance in the Ache Tribe

fullPassage: Hunters in the Ache tribe, living in the Paraguayan jungle, have a lot of ups and downs in their success at the hunt. Some days they bring home much more food than they could possibly eat; other days they come home empty-handed. If a man caught a wild pig and hoarded it for himself and his family, much of it would go to waste (there are no deep-freeze refrigerators in the Paraguayan jungle). Instead of living by a philosophy of "rugged individualism," however, hunters who have a lucky day share their meat with other families. During unlucky periods, individual hunters and their families would starve. And they don't just share a little; they share a lot — fully 90%. In exchange for this generosity, their neighbors share with them on days when the luck runs the other way. By exchanging resources, particularly those that are unpredictable and uncertain (like meat from the hunt, as opposed to vegetable crops), the group provides a mutual insurance policy against starvation.

questions.passage: Hunters in the Ache tribe, living in the Paraguayan jungle, have a lot of ups and downs in their (A)[success / failure] at the hunt. Some days they bring home much more food than they could possibly eat; other days they come home (B)[empty-handed / overloaded]. If a man caught a wild pig and (C)[hoarded / shared] it for himself and his family, much of it would go to waste.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸 (A), (B), (C)에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.analysis:
✅① success — empty-handed — hoarded = 원문과 일치
❌② failure는 success의 반의어
❌③ overloaded는 empty-handed의 반의어
❌④ shared(나누다)는 hoarded(비축하다)의 반의어

questions.passage: Instead of living by a philosophy of "rugged individualism," however, hunters who have a lucky day share their meat with other families. And they don't just share a little; they share a lot — fully 90%. In exchange for this (A)[generosity / selfishness], their neighbors share with them on days when the luck runs the other way. By exchanging resources, particularly those that are (B)[unpredictable / predictable] and uncertain (like meat from the hunt, as opposed to vegetable crops), the group provides a (C)[mutual / individual] insurance policy against starvation.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸 (A), (B), (C)에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.analysis:
✅④ generosity — unpredictable — mutual = 원문과 일치
❌① predictable은 unpredictable의 반의어
❌② selfishness는 generosity의 반의어
❌③ individual은 mutual의 반의어

questions.passage: Hunters in the Ache tribe have a lot of ups and downs in their success at the hunt. Some days they bring home much more food than they could (A)[possibly / barely] eat; other days they come home empty-handed. Instead of living by a philosophy of "rugged (B)[individualism / collectivism]," however, hunters who have a lucky day share their meat with other families. During (C)[unlucky / fortunate] periods, individual hunters and their families would starve.

det.analysis:
✅③ possibly — individualism — unlucky = 원문과 일치
❌① collectivism은 individualism의 반의어
❌② barely(간신히)는 possibly(아마)와 다름
❌④ fortunate(운 좋은)는 unlucky(불운한)의 반의어

questions.passage: Hunters in the Ache tribe, living in the Paraguayan jungle, have a lot of ups and downs in their success at the hunt. Some days they bring home much more food than they could possibly eat; other days they come home empty-handed. If a man caught a wild pig and hoarded it for himself and his family, much of it would go to ①<u>waste</u>. Instead of living by a philosophy of "rugged individualism," however, hunters who have a lucky day ②<u>share</u> their meat with other families. And they don't just share a little; they share a lot — fully 90%. In exchange for this generosity, their neighbors share with them on days when the luck runs the other way. By exchanging resources, the group provides a mutual insurance policy against ③<u>abundance</u>. During ④<u>unlucky</u> periods, individual hunters and their families would starve.
questions.stem: 밑줄 친 ①~④ 중에서 문맥상 낱말의 쓰임이 적절하지 않은 것은?

det.korean: 상호 보험 정책은 굶주림(starvation)에 대한 것이다. abundance(풍요)는 반대.
det.analysis:
❌③ abundance(풍요) → starvation(굶주림): 굶주림 방지를 위한 보험
✅① waste: 원문 일치 (낭비)
✅② share: 원문 일치 (나누다)
✅④ unlucky: 원문 일치 (불운한)

questions.passage: Hunters in the Ache tribe have a lot of ups and downs in their success at the hunt. If a man caught a wild pig and ①<u>hoarded</u> it for himself, much of it would go to waste. In exchange for this ②<u>generosity</u>, their neighbors share with them. By exchanging resources, particularly those that are ③<u>predictable</u> and uncertain (like meat from the hunt), the group provides a ④<u>mutual</u> insurance policy against starvation.
questions.stem: 밑줄 친 ①~④ 중에서 문맥상 낱말의 쓰임이 적절하지 않은 것은?

det.korean: 사냥에서 얻는 고기는 예측 불가능한(unpredictable) 자원이다. predictable(예측 가능한)은 반대.
det.analysis:
❌③ predictable(예측 가능한) → unpredictable(예측 불가능한)
✅① hoarded: 원문 일치 (비축하다)
✅② generosity: 원문 일치 (관대함)
✅④ mutual: 원문 일치 (상호적인)

questions.passage: Hunters in the Ache tribe have a lot of ups and downs. Some days they bring home much more food than they could possibly eat; other days they come home ①<u>empty-handed</u>. Instead of living by a philosophy of "rugged individualism," hunters share their meat. And they don't just share a little; they share a lot — fully 90%. questions.stem: 밑줄 친 ①~④ 중에서 문맥상 낱말의 쓰임이 적절하지 않은 것은?

det.korean: 이웃들은 운이 반대로 갈 때 나눠준다(share). withhold(보류하다)는 반대.
det.analysis:
❌② withhold(보류하다) → share(나누다): 이웃들도 나눠주는 상호적 관계
✅① empty-handed: 원문 일치
✅③ resources: 원문 일치
✅④ starvation: 원문 일치

det.analysis:

questions.passage: If a man caught a wild pig and <u>hoarded</u> it for himself and his family, much of it would go to waste (there are no deep-freeze refrigerators in the Paraguayan jungle).
questions.stem: 밑줄 친 hoarded와 의미가 가장 가까운 것은?

det.analysis:
✅① stockpiled: hoarded의 동의어 (비축하다)
❌② distributed: 분배하다 (반의어)
❌③ discarded: 버리다
❌④ consumed: 소비하다

det.korean: unpredictable = 예측 불가능한. erratic = 불규칙한, 변덕스러운.
det.analysis:
✅④ erratic: unpredictable의 동의어 (불규칙한)
❌① reliable: 신뢰할 수 있는 (반의어)
❌② consistent: 일관된 (반의어)
❌③ stable: 안정적인 (반의어)

questions.passage: In exchange for this <u>generosity</u>, their neighbors share with them on days when the luck runs the other way.

det.analysis:

❌① greed: 탐욕 (반의어)
❌③ hostility: 적대감
❌④ indifference: 무관심

det.analysis:
✅④ guaranteed: uncertain의 반의어 (보장된)
❌① doubtful: 의심스러운 (동의어)
❌② questionable: 의문의 여지가 있는 (유의어)
❌③ ambiguous: 모호한 (유의어)

questions.passage: Instead of living by a philosophy of "rugged individualism," however, hunters who have a lucky day share their meat with other families. In exchange for this generosity, their <u>neighbors</u> share with them on days when the luck runs the other way. The group provides a <u>mutual</u> insurance policy against starvation.

det.analysis:
✅① one-sided: mutual의 반의어 (일방적인)
❌② reciprocal: 상호적인 (동의어)
❌③ shared: 공유된 (유의어)
❌④ joint: 공동의 (유의어)

questions.passage:
(A) Hunters in the Ache tribe have a lot of ups and downs in their success at the hunt. Some days they bring home much food.

(B) The success of the new product exceeded everyone's expectations and boosted the company's revenue significantly.
questions.stem: 밑줄 친 success가 각 문맥에서 의미하는 바로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: (A) success = 성과, 결과 (사냥의 기복), (B) success = 성공, 번영 (제품의 성공)
det.analysis:
✅① (A) 성과/결과 — (B) 성공/번영
❌② 의미가 뒤바뀜
❌③ 둘 다 같은 의미
❌④ 둘 다 같은 의미
det.tip: success: (1) 성과, 결과 (ups and downs in success) (2) 성공, 번영
